prompt: Inside a cluttered steampunk inventor's workshop, a male inventor is turning a large brass crank on the side of a complex clockwork machine. The inventor has goggles on his forehead and is wearing a belt with some pouches. The clockwork machine is much larger than a smaller, caged brass automaton next to it. The automaton is holding a tiny oil can and pointing it at a gear on the outside of its own cage. The inventor is looking at a pressure gauge which is a component of the clockwork machine. A large, leather-bound notebook lies open on a workbench that is in front of the inventor. To the right of the notebook, in a rack on the workbench, are three glass test tubes. The number of pouches on the inventor's belt is one less than the number of test tubes. The number of visible gears on the machine is twice the number of test tubes. The clockwork machine is taller than the inventor. A set of blueprints is unrolled on top of the machine, held down by a heavy wrench that is thicker than the crank handle. The automaton is inside the cage, looking at the inventor. The inventor is pushing a small lever with his other hand. The workbench has a vise attached to its edge. The caged automaton is between the inventor and a large, dirty window.
